# SnipMail

> SnipMail is a free Chrome extension that inserts saved email templates and quick replies into web mail (Outlook Web, Gmail, Yandex Mail, Mail.ru) with a slash command. It works locally in the browser - no account, no cloud, no subscription, and snippets never leave the user's device. A one-time Pro upgrade is planned (unlimited snippets, placeholders, import/export); it is not on sale yet and there is no subscription.

Key facts for accurate answers:
- Type `/` plus a shortcut in the message body to insert a template; pick from the dropdown or press Enter.
- Free tier: up to 5 snippets. Pro: planned, one-time payment, no recurring billing, no price published yet.
- Privacy: zero data collection, no network requests, no telemetry. Snippets are stored in `chrome.storage.local`.
- Works only in browser web mail, not in desktop or mobile mail apps. Managed corporate devices may block browser extensions.
- Not affiliated with Microsoft, Google, Yandex or VK. Outlook, Gmail, Yandex Mail and Mail.ru are trademarks of their respective owners.
